This veterinarian is contemptuous and humiliating.

I asked for a payment plan, and he told me I could "let my pet die." (Business first!)
The prices are significantly higher than other clinics.
I took in a very sick animal and incurred a lot of expenses in a short period.
They refused to give me the bill if I paid in two installments and spoke to me as if I were begging.

No medication for wound healing: I have to manage with the pharmacy.

A profound lack of humanity.
Thank you so much for this excellent rating! 😄 The team at your Univet Marseille Lodi Veterinary Clinic …

I took my cat, Dix Grammes, to this vet on July 16th; he had an irritation on the tips of his paws.
The vet insisted on giving him antibiotic tablets. I would have preferred a topical cream, but apparently that was a bad idea, and he recommended the antibiotic. The vet didn't weigh my cat during this appointment, so I assume he based it on the weight recorded the first time I went two years ago. So, after some hesitation, I gave it to him that evening. He died the following morning from an allergic reaction or an overdose, apparently due to respiratory problems (pulmonary edema), that's what I was told at the vet clinic in La Plaine. I struggled to find a vet open between 5:30 and 9:00 a.m., and no one answered at the Delphes clinic. I'm very sad; I shouldn't have listened to him. I don't remember the antibiotic's reference number, but in any case, be careful with prescriptions; this one is known to cause respiratory problems. I find it a shame because it was the second time I went there for my cat, and the first time went well.

After desperately searching for a good vet in Marseille for years, I think I've finally found him. Dr. Ottolini was incredibly available and responsive, making the right diagnosis while ensuring my pet's comfort with the utmost care. He explained all the possible scenarios to me transparently, asked me to let him know how my pet was waking up after the sedation, and insisted on a free follow-up appointment a few days after treatment to check on her recovery... complete with a treat and a big smile. He's the only vet my dog ​​hasn't bitten because she felt so safe and at ease with his kindness. Finally, a vet who loves animals more than money, and it shows. I highly recommend him.
Thank you for this very positive feedback! We will do everything to maintain this rating! 😄 The team at your Univet Marseille Lodi Veterinary Clinic …

I came in as an emergency last year for my cat ABY, who had a blocked urethra… the doctor (I can't remember his name) was truly wonderful; he tried everything he could to save her, as did the team who cared for her during her stay, showering her with love and cuddles.
Unfortunately, a year later, it came back… and this time, unlike the first time, she has bladder cancer, which isn't treatable. She's undergoing chemotherapy and doesn't have much time left. But thanks to the doctor we saw, she was at least able to live longer, a real little queen until the end.
I'm writing to you now because I didn't think of it before, but thank you again.
